_intent: Maps each MCP server an agent can use to the name it is registered under on each platform. Agents declare MCP needs abstractly ("mcp": { "powerbi-modeling": ... }) and build.ps1 emits the platform-specific tool names. If an agent cannot see its MCP tools on some machine, the fix is here, not in the agent.
_claude_prefix: Claude Code names MCP tools mcp__<server>__<tool>. A server installed by a plugin gets mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>. Check the prefix with /mcp, or in any session's tool list.
_copilot_server: VS Code references MCP tools as <server>/<tool> or <server>/* - <server> is the name the server is registered under. Check it in Chat > Configure Tools, or in the key of your mcp.json. VS Code silently ignores tools it cannot find, so a wrong name makes the agent run without the tools rather than fail.

powerbi-modeling.description: Power BI modeling MCP - live semantic model read/write and DAX queries.
